pp2.7:1.1: kathañca puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggova hoti:
pp2.7:1.2: idhe’kacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekantakāḷakehi akusalehi dhammehi
pp2.7:1.3: evaṃ puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggova hoti.
pp2.7:2.2: idhe’kacco puggalo ummujjati sāhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sāhu hiri kusalesu dhammesu sāhu ottappaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sāhu viriyaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sāhu paññā kusalesu dhammesūti,
pp2.7:2.3: tassa sā saddhā neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati, hāyatimeva, tassa sā hiri neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatimeva, tassa taṃ ottappaṃ neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatimeva, tassa taṃ viriyaṃ neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatimeva, tassa sā paññā neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatimeva,
pp2.7:3.2: idhe’kacco puggalo ummujjati, sāhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sāhu hiri kusalesu dhammesu sāhu ottappaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sāhu viriyaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sāhu paññā kusalesu dhammesūti.
pp2.7:3.3: tassa sā saddhā neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitā hoti, tassa sā hiri neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitā hoti, tassa taṃ ottappaṃ neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitaṃ hoti, tassa taṃ viriyaṃ neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitaṃ hoti, tassa sā paññā neva hāyati, no vaḍḍhati ṭhitā hoti
pp2.7:4.2: idhe’kacco puggalo ummujjati, sāhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu hiri kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu ottappaṃ kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu viriyaṃ kusalesu dhammesu. sāhu paññā kusalesu dhammesūti.
pp2.7:4.3: so tiṇṇā saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
pp2.7:5.2: idhe’kacco puggalo ummujjati, sāhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu hiri kusalesu dhammesu sāhu ottappaṃ kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu viriyaṃ kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu paññā kusalesu dhammesūti,
pp2.7:5.3: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
pp2.7:6.2: idhe’kacco puggalo ummujjati, sāhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sāhu hiri kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu ottappaṃ kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu viriyaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sāhu paññā kusalesu dhammesūti,
pp2.7:6.3: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyi anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
pp2.7:7.1: kathañca puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo:
pp2.7:7.2: idhekacco puggalo ummujjati, sāhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu hiri kusalesu, dhammesu, sāhu ottappaṃ kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu viriyaṃ kusalesu dhammesu, sāhu paññā kusalesu dhammesūti,
pp2.7:7.3: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
pp2.7:7.4: evaṃ puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāraṃgato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
pp2.7:8.2: idhe’kacco puggalo aṭṭhavimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti,
pp2.7:14.2: yassa puggalassa sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa saddhindriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti, saddhāvāhī saddhāpubbaṅgamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti.
pp2.7:14.4: sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo saddhānusārī. phale ṭhito saddhāvimutto. sattaka
